bullets.text: Sports Development plans upgrades for three neighbourhood grounds including a running track at Shenoy Nagar, and the office should monitor these projects.
Adyar and Mandavelipakkam will receive new sports facilities like a hockey court and football practice area, and the office should track their progress.
Residents protested and besieged the Poondi block development office, and the office should watch for further local unrest.
Malaimurasu reported on a gang stealing government lands involving the Tiruttani Sub-Registrar, and the office should monitor action taken.
Ambattur police inspected and destroyed ganja plants in the Pudur area, and the office should support police anti-drug efforts.

stories.title: Three neighbourhood grounds to get game-changing upgrades
takeaways: Adyar will receive a new practice hockey court as part of neighbourhood sports upgrades in Chennai.
The initiative aims to improve local athletic facilities and encourage youth sports participation.
stories.snippet: Chennai: A six-lane running track at Shenoy Nagar, a practice hockey court at Adyar and a football practice facility at Mandavelipakkam are some sporting facilities planned at neighbourhood grounds by Sports Development…
